top_signals.title: US 30-Year Bonds Erase Gains From Treasury’s Buyback Surprise
top_signals.summary: US bonds unwound all of the gains that followed Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s plan to increase buybacks of longer-dated debt, a sign that investors see it as only a short-lived remedy to curb borrowing costs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Cybersecurity firm unveils crypto phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers
top_signals.summary: Rapid7 unveiled a new cryptocurrency phishing campaign targeting 885,000 phone numbers, aiming to steal investors’ holdings by redirecting them to fake wallet provider websites.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
